places.name: The Resonance Crucible
places.epithet: A laboratory that learned to defend itself
places.text: The fortress-complex at the summit: lead-lined halls, reinforced glass vats and sealed scriptoriums, where research is organised round the three sanctioned pillars of Mana Conversion, Corruption Containment and Glass Circuitry. From without it resembles a keep. The town took its name from it long before anyone gave it a charter.
places.source: Of Northreach Weave, the Iron Threshold

places.name: The Chapel of Tolerances
places.epithet: Congregants listen for their own family names
places.text: The Weave's only temple of note, at the Crucible's heart. It holds no idol; its walls are lined floor to ceiling with bronze plates, each stamped with the date, place and margin of a structural failure, and its priests read from them on feast-days.
places.source: Of Northreach Weave, the Iron Threshold

places.name: The Chapel Close
places.text: The slate-paved square round the Chapel, warm underfoot in all weathers: its seams are cut with grooves that bleed the Vessels' excess heat into the ground so that it never ices.
places.source: Of Northreach Weave, the Iron Threshold

places.name: The Sealed Scriptoriums
places.text: The highest terrace below the fortress, where laboratories, archives and fortified offices review the Crucible's results and decide which of them anyone else will ever read.
places.source: Of Northreach Weave, the Iron Threshold

places.name: The Containment Yards
places.epithet: Sub-levels whose purpose has been lost to reinforcement
places.text: Testing halls and containment yards on the terrace beneath the laboratories, where sinks are proved before they go to the Orcholis Aperture, and where some of the older sub-levels are no longer entered at all.
places.source: Of Northreach Weave, the Iron Threshold

places.name: The Deepdelve Shaft-head
places.epithet: Light is indirect. Warmth is routed. Silence is engineered.
places.text: Where the shafts, ramps and pressure-rated stairwells of the town's lower conclaves go down into the Deepdelve Faces under the Crucible. Entire clan lines live closer to bedrock than sky; most of the Weave's candles end up down there.
places.source: Of Northreach Weave, the Iron Threshold

places.name: The Waste-Heat Works
places.epithet: Nothing warm is wasted in Northreach
places.text: The potteries, distilleries and preserving-houses that the Crucible runs on heat bled from the Vessels, because its cold hills will not feed it otherwise.
places.source: Of Northreach Weave, the Iron Threshold

places.name: The Upper Terraces
places.text: The stone terraces that step down from the fortress: laboratories and archives highest, testing halls beneath them, and beneath those, the people.
places.source: Of Northreach Weave, the Iron Threshold

places.name: The Conclaves
places.epithet: Each begins as shelter and ends as infrastructure
places.text: The dwarven residential quarters, which are not streets or blocks but irregular stone masses accreted, reinforced and re-hollowed over generations. Hearths sit where heat already sheds; walls thicken where the resonance hums strongest.
places.source: Of Northreach Weave, the Iron Threshold

places.name: The Penilworth Trail
places.text: The main highland road east from the Crucible through Bybdetos to the Penilworth fort.
places.source: Of Northreach Weave, the Iron Threshold

places.name: The Forge Run road
places.text: South down the river valley where the Infusion Forges burn, past Naurias and Pekion.
places.source: Of Northreach Weave, the Iron Threshold
